english.note: Use this all-purpose rendering for something so valuable that money cannot measure it, including a treasured relationship or possession.

examples.english: This necklace my grandmother left me is priceless.
examples.traditional: 呢條項鏈係阿嫲留畀我嘅，真係無價。
